purpose: Document published components, not a complete carrier budget or adopted parameters

sources.locator: Printed page 56072, final regulatory tables in sections 367.40 and 367.50
Do You Qualify?; Fees and Payment Information; More Information
Fees and Payment Information: distance percentages per jurisdiction
FAQ body: individual operating authority fees; last updated May 20, 2023

ucr.bracketBasis: Commercial motor vehicles owned or operated, as defined in the regulatory table; not number of legs in this quote
ucr.monthlyNormalization: annualUsd / 12; preserve annual basis, do not multiply a prematurely rounded monthly display by 12
ucr.limitations: Reference group is not an identified registrant. Same binational group does not establish one legal registrant. Do not charge the entity fee once per tractor, trailer or trip; applicability and allocation remain unselected. Article effective date is not the registration year. Recheck subsequent amendments before use.

tokenTrailer.normalization: 15 / 12; for a prepaid term y, base cash = 15*y and service months = 12*y
tokenTrailer.scope: One eligible semitrailer registration, not all trailer ownership costs
tokenTrailer.eligibility: Gross weight greater than 6,000 lb; qualifying tractor and plate type. A 53-foot length alone does not certify eligibility or Texas registration.
tokenTrailer.limitations: Base only, excludes applicable local fees and other registration/title/compliance costs. Non-expiring plates do not mean perpetual paid registration. Same trailer must not be billed again for the US leg. No actual registration jurisdiction selected.

authority.limitations: Opening event, not an annual USD 300 renewal or automatic USD 25/month. Neither a new applicant nor an existing authority has been identified. An explicit setup-cost scenario and horizon would be needed to amortize.

mxPermitObservations.scope: Expedition of federal general freight service permit
mxPermitObservations.limitations: Undated table is not proof of 2026 tariff validity. Do not sum alternative channels or convert to monthly USD without period, FX basis and cost treatment.

mxPermitObservations.scope: General freight trailer hauling in US border strip/crossings, not Mexico DF long-haul authorization
mxPermitObservations.limitations: Separate procedure and coverage, not an interchangeable long-haul fee or automatic extra charge. Applicable entity and validity unresolved.

mxHistoricalIndexConflict.limitations: Different indexed amounts, no verified validity year or live body. Not current evidence and not averaged with the archived table.

irp.basis: Distance percentages for the vehicle or fleet in each jurisdiction; reporting-period method rather than this one-way quote distance
irp.limitations: Base jurisdiction, registered weight, reporting distance or authorized average-distance basis, registration period and compatible profile unresolved. A flat Texas combination-plate figure is not the complete apportioned registration budget. Other taxes/compliance costs are not inferred zero.

capitalFreshness.limitations: Used 2021 Cascadia offer, 694920 km; not a transaction, capitalizable acquisition total, residual value or complete monthly depreciation. Availability subject to seller confirmation.
Keep original September 29 observation intact. Do not present earlier 45000 with unresolved currency as a current available USD acquisition anchor.

outcome.numericalCoverage: 12 year/bracket fees, one trailer annual base and one authority application fee; two MX procedure/channel observations with unresolved validity
outcome.limitations: Components are research evidence only. No complete permit row or capital/insurance/overhead budget is inferred from these numbers. No DB, canonical input, pricing-engine, UI or external configuration write.
